    3   # Choosing Pokémon to switch
    4   #=============================================================================
    5   # Checks whether the replacement Pokémon (at party index idxParty) can enter
    6   # battle.
    7   # NOTE: Messages are only shown while in the party screen when choosing a
    8   #       command for the next round.
    9   def pbCanSwitchIn?(idxBattler, idxParty, partyScene = nil)
   10     return true if idxParty < 0
   11     party = pbParty(idxBattler)
   12     return false if idxParty >= party.length
   13     return false if !party[idxParty]
   14     if party[idxParty].egg?
   15       partyScene&.pbDisplay(_INTL("An Egg can't battle!"))
   16       return false
   17     end
   18     if !pbIsOwner?(idxBattler, idxParty)
   19       if partyScene
   20         owner = pbGetOwnerFromPartyIndex(idxBattler, idxParty)
   21         partyScene.pbDisplay(_INTL("You can't switch {1}'s Pokémon with one of yours!", owner.name))
   22       end
   23       return false
   24     end
   25     if party[idxParty].fainted?
   26       partyScene&.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} has no energy left to battle!", party[idxParty].name))
   27       return false
   28     end
   29     if pbFindBattler(idxParty, idxBattler)
   30       partyScene&.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} is already in battle!", party[idxParty].name))
   31       return false
   32     end
   33     return true
   34   end
   35 
   36   # Check whether the currently active Pokémon (at battler index idxBattler) can
   37   # switch out.
   38   def pbCanSwitchOut?(idxBattler, partyScene = nil)
   39     battler = @battlers[idxBattler]
   40     return true if battler.fainted?
   41     # Ability/item effects that allow switching no matter what
   42     if battler.abilityActive? && Battle::AbilityEffects.triggerCertainSwitching(battler.ability, battler, self)
   43       return true
   44     end
   45     if battler.itemActive? && Battle::ItemEffects.triggerCertainSwitching(battler.item, battler, self)
   46       return true
   47     end
   48     # Other certain switching effects
   49     return true if Settings::MORE_TYPE_EFFECTS && battler.pbHasType?(:GHOST)
   50     # Other certain trapping effects
   51     if battler.trappedInBattle?
   52       partyScene&.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} can't be switched out!", battler.pbThis))
   53       return false
   54     end
   55     # Trapping abilities/items
   56     allOtherSideBattlers(idxBattler).each do |b|
   57       next if !b.abilityActive?
   58       if Battle::AbilityEffects.triggerTrappingByTarget(b.ability, battler, b, self)
   59         partyScene&.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1}'s {2} prevents switching!", b.pbThis, b.abilityName))
   60         return false
   61       end
   62     end
   63     allOtherSideBattlers(idxBattler).each do |b|
   64       next if !b.itemActive?
   65       if Battle::ItemEffects.triggerTrappingByTarget(b.item, battler, b, self)
   66         partyScene&.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1}'s {2} prevents switching!", b.pbThis, b.itemName))
   67         return false
   68       end
   69     end
   70     return true
   71   end
   72 
   73   # Check whether the currently active Pokémon (at battler index idxBattler) can
   74   # switch out (and that its replacement at party index idxParty can switch in).
   75   # NOTE: Messages are only shown while in the party screen when choosing a
   76   #       command for the next round.
   77   def pbCanSwitch?(idxBattler, idxParty = -1, partyScene = nil)
   78     # Check whether party Pokémon can switch in
   79     return false if !pbCanSwitchIn?(idxBattler, idxParty, partyScene)
   80     # Make sure another battler isn't already choosing to switch to the party
   81     # Pokémon
   82     allSameSideBattlers(idxBattler).each do |b|
   83       next if choices[b.index][0] != :SwitchOut || choices[b.index][1] != idxParty
   84       partyScene&.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} has already been selected.",
   85                                   pbParty(idxBattler)[idxParty].name))
   86       return false
   87     end
   88     # Check whether battler can switch out
   89     return pbCanSwitchOut?(idxBattler, partyScene)
   90   end

   93     pbParty(idxBattler).each_with_index do |_pkmn, i|

   95     end
   96     return false
   97   end

  111   # Open party screen and potentially choose a Pokémon to switch with. Used in
  112   # all instances where the party screen is opened.
  113   def pbPartyScreen(idxBattler, checkLaxOnly = false, canCancel = false, shouldRegister = false)
  114     ret = -1
  115     @scene.pbPartyScreen(idxBattler, canCancel) do |idxParty, partyScene|
  116       if checkLaxOnly
  117         next false if !pbCanSwitchIn?(idxBattler, idxParty, partyScene)
  118       elsif !pbCanSwitch?(idxBattler, idxParty, partyScene)
  119         next false
  120       end
  121       if shouldRegister && (idxParty < 0 || !pbRegisterSwitch(idxBattler, idxParty))
  122         next false
  123       end
  124       ret = idxParty
  125       next true
  126     end
  127     return ret
  128   end

  130   # For choosing a replacement Pokémon when prompted in the middle of other
  131   # things happening (U-turn, Baton Pass, in def pbEORSwitch).
  132   def pbSwitchInBetween(idxBattler, checkLaxOnly = false, canCancel = false)
  133     return pbPartyScreen(idxBattler, checkLaxOnly, canCancel) if !@controlPlayer && pbOwnedByPlayer?(idxBattler)
  134     return @battleAI.pbDefaultChooseNewEnemy(idxBattler)
  135   end

  137   #=============================================================================
  138   # Switching Pokémon
  139   #=============================================================================
  140   # General switching method that checks if any Pokémon need to be sent out and,
  141   # if so, does. Called at the end of each round.
  142   def pbEORSwitch(favorDraws = false)
  143     return if @decision > 0 && !favorDraws
  144     return if @decision == 5 && favorDraws
  145     pbJudge
  146     return if @decision > 0
  147     # Check through each fainted battler to see if that spot can be filled.
  148     switched = []
  149     loop do
  150       switched.clear
  151       @battlers.each do |b|
  152         next if !b || !b.fainted?
  153         idxBattler = b.index
  154         next if !pbCanChooseNonActive?(idxBattler)
  155         if !pbOwnedByPlayer?(idxBattler)   # Opponent/ally is switching in
  156           next if b.wild?   # Wild Pokémon can't switch
  157           idxPartyNew = pbSwitchInBetween(idxBattler)
  158           opponent = pbGetOwnerFromBattlerIndex(idxBattler)
  159           # NOTE: The player is only offered the chance to switch their own
  160           #       Pokémon when an opponent replaces a fainted Pokémon in single
  161           #       battles. In double battles, etc. there is no such offer.
  162           if @internalBattle && @switchStyle && trainerBattle? && pbSideSize(0) == 1 &&
  163              opposes?(idxBattler) && !@battlers[0].fainted? && !switched.include?(0) &&
  164              pbCanChooseNonActive?(0) && @battlers[0].effects[PBEffects::Outrage] == 0
  165             idxPartyForName = idxPartyNew
  166             enemyParty = pbParty(idxBattler)
  167             if enemyParty[idxPartyNew].ability == :ILLUSION && !pbCheckGlobalAbility(:NEUTRALIZINGGAS)
  168               new_index = pbLastInTeam(idxBattler)
  169               idxPartyForName = new_index if new_index >= 0 && new_index != idxPartyNew
  170             end
  171             if pbDisplayConfirm(_INTL("{1} is about to send out {2}. Will you switch your Pokémon?",
  172                                       opponent.full_name, enemyParty[idxPartyForName].name))
  173               idxPlayerPartyNew = pbSwitchInBetween(0, false, true)
  174               if idxPlayerPartyNew >= 0
  175                 pbMessageOnRecall(@battlers[0])
  176                 pbRecallAndReplace(0, idxPlayerPartyNew)
  177                 switched.push(0)
  178               end
  179             end
  180           end
  181           pbRecallAndReplace(idxBattler, idxPartyNew)
  182           switched.push(idxBattler)
  183         elsif trainerBattle?   # Player switches in in a trainer battle
  184           idxPlayerPartyNew = pbGetReplacementPokemonIndex(idxBattler)   # Owner chooses
  185           pbRecallAndReplace(idxBattler, idxPlayerPartyNew)
  186           switched.push(idxBattler)
  187         else   # Player's Pokémon has fainted in a wild battle
  188           switch = false
  189           if pbDisplayConfirm(_INTL("Use next Pokémon?"))
  190             switch = true

    5   def pbCanUseItemOnPokemon?(item, pkmn, battler, scene, showMessages = true)

   10     # Embargo
   11     if battler && battler.effects[PBEffects::Embargo] > 0

   14                               battler.pbThis(true)))
   15       end

   19     if pkmn.hyper_mode && !GameData::Item.get(item)&.is_scent?
   20       scene.pbDisplay(_INTL("It won't have any effect.")) if showMessages

   22     end
   23     return true
   24   end

   14         msg = _INTL("{1}'s {2} is disabled!", pbThis, move.name)
   15         (commandPhase) ? @battle.pbDisplayPaused(msg) : @battle.pbDisplay(msg)

   17       return false
   18     end
   19     # Heal Block
   20     if @effects[PBEffects::HealBlock] > 0 && move.healingMove?
   21       if showMessages
   22         msg = _INTL("{1} can't use {2} because of Heal Block!", pbThis, move.name)
   23         (commandPhase) ? @battle.pbDisplayPaused(msg) : @battle.pbDisplay(msg)
   24       end
   25       return false
   26     end
   27     # Gravity
   28     if @battle.field.effects[PBEffects::Gravity] > 0 && move.unusableInGravity?
   29       if showMessages
   30         msg = _INTL("{1} can't use {2} because of gravity!", pbThis, move.name)
   31         (commandPhase) ? @battle.pbDisplayPaused(msg) : @battle.pbDisplay(msg)
   32       end

   34     end

   37       if showMessages

   41       return false

   44     @effects[PBEffects::ChoiceBand] = nil if !pbHasMove?(@effects[PBEffects::ChoiceBand])
   45     if @effects[PBEffects::ChoiceBand] && move.id != @effects[PBEffects::ChoiceBand]
   46       choiced_move = GameData::Move.try_get(@effects[PBEffects::ChoiceBand])
   47       if choiced_move
   48         if hasActiveItem?([:CHOICEBAND, :CHOICESPECS, :CHOICESCARF])
   49           if showMessages
   50             msg = _INTL("The {1} only allows the use of {2}!", itemName, choiced_move.name)
   51             (commandPhase) ? @battle.pbDisplayPaused(msg) : @battle.pbDisplay(msg)
   52           end
   53           return false
   54         elsif hasActiveAbility?(:GORILLATACTICS)
   55           if showMessages
   56             msg = _INTL("{1} can only use {2}!", pbThis, choiced_move.name)
   57             (commandPhase) ? @battle.pbDisplayPaused(msg) : @battle.pbDisplay(msg)
   58           end
   59           return false
   60         end
   61       end
   62     end
   63     # Taunt
   64     if @effects[PBEffects::Taunt] > 0 && move.statusMove? && !specialUsage
   65       if showMessages
   66         msg = _INTL("{1} can't use {2} after the taunt!", pbThis, move.name)
   67         (commandPhase) ? @battle.pbDisplayPaused(msg) : @battle.pbDisplay(msg)
   68       end
   69       return false
   70     end
   71     # Torment
   72     if @effects[PBEffects::Torment] && !@effects[PBEffects::Instructed] && !specialUsage &&
   73        @lastMoveUsed && move.id == @lastMoveUsed && move.id != @battle.struggle.id
   74       if showMessages
   75         msg = _INTL("{1} can't use the same move twice in a row due to the torment!", pbThis)
   76         (commandPhase) ? @battle.pbDisplayPaused(msg) : @battle.pbDisplay(msg)
   77       end
   78       return false
   79     end
   80     # Imprison
   81     if @battle.allOtherSideBattlers(@index).any? { |b| b.effects[PBEffects::Imprison] && b.pbHasMove?(move.id) }
   82       if showMessages
   83         msg = _INTL("{1} can't use its sealed {2}!", pbThis, move.name)
   84         (commandPhase) ? @battle.pbDisplayPaused(msg) : @battle.pbDisplay(msg)
   85       end
   86       return false
   87     end
   88     # Assault Vest (prevents choosing status moves but doesn't prevent
   89     # executing them)
   90     if hasActiveItem?(:ASSAULTVEST) && move.statusMove? && move.function_code != "UseMoveTargetIsAboutToUse" && commandPhase
   91       if showMessages
   92         msg = _INTL("The effects of the {1} prevent status moves from being used!", itemName)
   93         (commandPhase) ? @battle.pbDisplayPaused(msg) : @battle.pbDisplay(msg)
   94       end
   95       return false
   96     end

   98     return false if !move.pbCanChooseMove?(self, commandPhase, showMessages)

  105   # Return true if Pokémon continues attacking (although it may have chosen to
  106   # use a different move in disobedience), or false if attack stops.
  107   def pbObedienceCheck?(choice)
  108     return true if usingMultiTurnAttack?
  109     return true if choice[0] != :UseMove
  110     return true if !@battle.internalBattle
  111     return true if !@battle.pbOwnedByPlayer?(@index)
  112     disobedient = false
  113     # Pokémon may be disobedient; calculate if it is
  114     badge_level = 10 * (@battle.pbPlayer.badge_count + 1)
  115     badge_level = GameData::GrowthRate.max_level if @battle.pbPlayer.badge_count >= 8
  116     if Settings::ANY_HIGH_LEVEL_POKEMON_CAN_DISOBEY ||
  117        (Settings::FOREIGN_HIGH_LEVEL_POKEMON_CAN_DISOBEY && @pokemon.foreign?(@battle.pbPlayer))
  118       if @level > badge_level
  119         a = ((@level + badge_level) * @battle.pbRandom(256) / 256).floor
  120         disobedient |= (a >= badge_level)
  121       end
  122     end
  123     disobedient |= !pbHyperModeObedience(choice[2])
  124     return true if !disobedient
  125     # Pokémon is disobedient; make it do something else
  126     return pbDisobey(choice, badge_level)
  127   end

  129   def pbDisobey(choice, badge_level)
  130     move = choice[2]
  131     PBDebug.log("[Disobedience] #{pbThis} disobeyed")
  132     @effects[PBEffects::Rage] = false
  133     # Do nothing if using Snore/Sleep Talk
  134     if @status == :SLEEP && move.usableWhenAsleep?
  135       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} ignored orders and kept sleeping!", pbThis))
  136       return false
  137     end
  138     b = ((@level + badge_level) * @battle.pbRandom(256) / 256).floor
  139     # Use another move
  140     if b < badge_level
  141       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} ignored orders!", pbThis))
  142       return false if !@battle.pbCanShowFightMenu?(@index)
  143       otherMoves = []
  144       eachMoveWithIndex do |_m, i|
  145         next if i == choice[1]
  146         otherMoves.push(i) if @battle.pbCanChooseMove?(@index, i, false)
  147       end
  148       return false if otherMoves.length == 0   # No other move to use; do nothing
  149       newChoice = otherMoves[@battle.pbRandom(otherMoves.length)]
  150       choice[1] = newChoice
  151       choice[2] = @moves[newChoice]
  152       choice[3] = -1
  153       return true
  154     end
  155     c = @level - badge_level
  156     r = @battle.pbRandom(256)
  157     # Fall asleep
  158     if r < c && pbCanSleep?(self, false)
  159       pbSleepSelf(_INTL("{1} began to nap!", pbThis))
  160       return false
  161     end
  162     # Hurt self in confusion
  163     r -= c
  164     if r < c && @status != :SLEEP
  165       pbConfusionDamage(_INTL("{1} won't obey! It hurt itself in its confusion!", pbThis))

   54   # This is the code actually used to generate a Battle::Move object. The
   55   # object generated is a subclass of this one which depends on the move's
   56   # function code.
   57   def self.from_pokemon_move(battle, move)
   58     validate move => Pokemon::Move
   59     code = move.function_code || "None"
   60     if code[/^\d/]   # Begins with a digit
   61       class_name = sprintf("Battle::Move::Effect%s", code)
   62     else
   63       class_name = sprintf("Battle::Move::%s", code)
   64     end
   65     if Object.const_defined?(class_name)
   66       return Object.const_get(class_name).new(battle, move)
   67     end
   68     return Battle::Move::Unimplemented.new(battle, move)
   69   end

 1300 # NOTE: This allows Hidden Power to be Fairy-type (if you have that type in your
 1301 #       game). I don't care that the official games don't work like that.
 1302 def pbHiddenPower(pkmn)
 1303   iv = pkmn.iv
 1304   idxType = 0
 1305   power = 60
 1306   types = []
 1307   GameData::Type.each do |t|
 1308     types[t.icon_position] ||= []
 1309     types[t.icon_position].push(t.id) if !t.pseudo_type && ![:NORMAL, :SHADOW].include?(t.id)
 1310   end
 1311   types.flatten!.compact!
 1312   idxType |= (iv[:HP] & 1)
 1313   idxType |= (iv[:ATTACK] & 1) << 1
 1314   idxType |= (iv[:DEFENSE] & 1) << 2
 1315   idxType |= (iv[:SPEED] & 1) << 3
 1316   idxType |= (iv[:SPECIAL_ATTACK] & 1) << 4
 1317   idxType |= (iv[:SPECIAL_DEFENSE] & 1) << 5
 1318   idxType = (types.length - 1) * idxType / 63
 1319   type = types[idxType]
 1320   if Settings::MECHANICS_GENERATION <= 5
 1321     powerMin = 30
 1322     powerMax = 70
 1323     power |= (iv[:HP] & 2) >> 1
 1324     power |= (iv[:ATTACK] & 2)
 1325     power |= (iv[:DEFENSE] & 2) << 1
 1326     power |= (iv[:SPEED] & 2) << 2
 1327     power |= (iv[:SPECIAL_ATTACK] & 2) << 3
 1328     power |= (iv[:SPECIAL_DEFENSE] & 2) << 4
 1329     power = powerMin + ((powerMax - powerMin) * power / 63)
 1330   end
 1331   return [type, power]
 1332 end

  136   def pbCalculatePriority(fullCalc = false, indexArray = nil)
  137     needRearranging = false
  138     if fullCalc

  140       # Recalculate everything from scratch
  141       randomOrder = Array.new(maxBattlerIndex + 1) { |i| i }
  142       (randomOrder.length - 1).times do |i|   # Can't use shuffle! here
  143         r = i + pbRandom(randomOrder.length - i)
  144         randomOrder[i], randomOrder[r] = randomOrder[r], randomOrder[i]
  145       end
  146       @priority.clear
  147       (0..maxBattlerIndex).each do |i|
  148         b = @battlers[i]
  149         next if !b
  150         # [battler, speed, sub-priority from ability, sub-priority from item,
  151         #  final sub-priority, priority, tie-breaker order]
  152         entry = [b, b.pbSpeed, 0, 0, 0, 0, randomOrder[i]]
  153         if @choices[b.index][0] == :UseMove || @choices[b.index][0] == :Shift
  154           # Calculate move's priority
  155           if @choices[b.index][0] == :UseMove
  156             move = @choices[b.index][2]
  157             pri = move.pbPriority(b)
  158             if b.abilityActive?
  159               pri = Battle::AbilityEffects.triggerPriorityChange(b.ability, b, move, pri)
  160             end
  161             entry[5] = pri
  162             @choices[b.index][4] = pri
  163           end
  164           # Calculate sub-priority changes (first/last within priority bracket)
  165           # Abilities (Stall)
  166           if b.abilityActive?
  167             entry[2] = Battle::AbilityEffects.triggerPriorityBracketChange(b.ability, b, self)
  168           end
  169           # Items (Quick Claw, Custap Berry, Lagging Tail, Full Incense)
  170           if b.itemActive?
  171             entry[3] = Battle::ItemEffects.triggerPriorityBracketChange(b.item, b, self)
  172           end
  173         end
  174         @priority.push(entry)
  175       end
  176       needRearranging = true
  177     else
  178       if (@field.effects[PBEffects::TrickRoom] > 0) != @priorityTrickRoom
  179         needRearranging = true
  180         @priorityTrickRoom = (@field.effects[PBEffects::TrickRoom] > 0)
  181       end
  182       # Recheck all battler speeds and changes to priority caused by abilities
  183       @priority.each do |entry|
  184         next if !entry
  185         next if indexArray && !indexArray.include?(entry[0].index)
  186         # Recalculate speed of battler
  187         newSpeed = entry[0].pbSpeed
  188         needRearranging = true if newSpeed != entry[1]
  189         entry[1] = newSpeed
  190         # Recalculate move's priority in case ability has changed
  191         choice = @choices[entry[0].index]
  192         if choice[0] == :UseMove

  194           pri = move.pbPriority(entry[0])
  195           if entry[0].abilityActive?

  197           end
  198           needRearranging = true if pri != entry[5]

    2   #=============================================================================
    3   # Decide whether the trainer is allowed to tell the Pokémon to use the given
    4   # move. Called when choosing a command for the round.
    5   # Also called when processing the Pokémon's action, because these effects also
    6   # prevent Pokémon action. Relevant because these effects can become active
    7   # earlier in the same round (after choosing the command but before using the
    8   # move) or an unusable move may be called by another move such as Metronome.
    9   #=============================================================================
   10   def pbCanChooseMove?(move, commandPhase, showMessages = true, specialUsage = false)
   11     # Disable
   12     if @effects[PBEffects::DisableMove] == move.id && !specialUsage
   13       if showMessages
   14         msg = _INTL("{1}'s {2} is disabled!", pbThis, move.name)
   15         (commandPhase) ? @battle.pbDisplayPaused(msg) : @battle.pbDisplay(msg)
   16       end
   17       return false
   18     end
   19     # Heal Block
   20     if @effects[PBEffects::HealBlock] > 0 && move.healingMove?
   21       if showMessages
   22         msg = _INTL("{1} can't use {2} because of Heal Block!", pbThis, move.name)
   23         (commandPhase) ? @battle.pbDisplayPaused(msg) : @battle.pbDisplay(msg)
   24       end
   25       return false
   26     end
   27     # Gravity
   28     if @battle.field.effects[PBEffects::Gravity] > 0 && move.unusableInGravity?
   29       if showMessages
   30         msg = _INTL("{1} can't use {2} because of gravity!", pbThis, move.name)
   31         (commandPhase) ? @battle.pbDisplayPaused(msg) : @battle.pbDisplay(msg)
   32       end
   33       return false
   34     end
   35     # Throat Chop
   36     if @effects[PBEffects::ThroatChop] > 0 && move.soundMove?
   37       if showMessages
   38         msg = _INTL("{1} can't use {2} because of Throat Chop!", pbThis, move.name)
   39         (commandPhase) ? @battle.pbDisplayPaused(msg) : @battle.pbDisplay(msg)
   40       end
   41       return false
   42     end
   43     # Choice Band/Gorilla Tactics
   44     @effects[PBEffects::ChoiceBand] = nil if !pbHasMove?(@effects[PBEffects::ChoiceBand])
   45     if @effects[PBEffects::ChoiceBand] && move.id != @effects[PBEffects::ChoiceBand]
   46       choiced_move = GameData::Move.try_get(@effects[PBEffects::ChoiceBand])
   47       if choiced_move
   48         if hasActiveItem?([:CHOICEBAND, :CHOICESPECS, :CHOICESCARF])
   49           if showMessages
   50             msg = _INTL("The {1} only allows the use of {2}!", itemName, choiced_move.name)
   51             (commandPhase) ? @battle.pbDisplayPaused(msg) : @battle.pbDisplay(msg)
   52           end
   53           return false
   54         elsif hasActiveAbility?(:GORILLATACTICS)
   55           if showMessages
   56             msg = _INTL("{1} can only use {2}!", pbThis, choiced_move.name)
   57             (commandPhase) ? @battle.pbDisplayPaused(msg) : @battle.pbDisplay(msg)
   58           end
   59           return false
   60         end
   61       end
   62     end
   63     # Taunt
   64     if @effects[PBEffects::Taunt] > 0 && move.statusMove? && !specialUsage
   65       if showMessages
   66         msg = _INTL("{1} can't use {2} after the taunt!", pbThis, move.name)
   67         (commandPhase) ? @battle.pbDisplayPaused(msg) : @battle.pbDisplay(msg)
   68       end
   69       return false
   70     end
   71     # Torment
   72     if @effects[PBEffects::Torment] && !@effects[PBEffects::Instructed] && !specialUsage &&
   73        @lastMoveUsed && move.id == @lastMoveUsed && move.id != @battle.struggle.id
   74       if showMessages
   75         msg = _INTL("{1} can't use the same move twice in a row due to the torment!", pbThis)
   76         (commandPhase) ? @battle.pbDisplayPaused(msg) : @battle.pbDisplay(msg)
   77       end
   78       return false
   79     end
   80     # Imprison
   81     if @battle.allOtherSideBattlers(@index).any? { |b| b.effects[PBEffects::Imprison] && b.pbHasMove?(move.id) }
   82       if showMessages
   83         msg = _INTL("{1} can't use its sealed {2}!", pbThis, move.name)
   84         (commandPhase) ? @battle.pbDisplayPaused(msg) : @battle.pbDisplay(msg)
   85       end
   86       return false
   87     end
   88     # Assault Vest (prevents choosing status moves but doesn't prevent
   89     # executing them)
   90     if hasActiveItem?(:ASSAULTVEST) && move.statusMove? && move.function_code != "UseMoveTargetIsAboutToUse" && commandPhase
   91       if showMessages
   92         msg = _INTL("The effects of the {1} prevent status moves from being used!", itemName)
   93         (commandPhase) ? @battle.pbDisplayPaused(msg) : @battle.pbDisplay(msg)
   94       end
   95       return false
   96     end
   97     # Belch
   98     return false if !move.pbCanChooseMove?(self, commandPhase, showMessages)
   99     return true
  100   end

  105   # Return true if Pokémon continues attacking (although it may have chosen to
  106   # use a different move in disobedience), or false if attack stops.
  107   def pbObedienceCheck?(choice)
  108     return true if usingMultiTurnAttack?
  109     return true if choice[0] != :UseMove
  110     return true if !@battle.internalBattle
  111     return true if !@battle.pbOwnedByPlayer?(@index)
  112     disobedient = false
  113     # Pokémon may be disobedient; calculate if it is
  114     badge_level = 10 * (@battle.pbPlayer.badge_count + 1)
  115     badge_level = GameData::GrowthRate.max_level if @battle.pbPlayer.badge_count >= 8
  116     if Settings::ANY_HIGH_LEVEL_POKEMON_CAN_DISOBEY ||
  117        (Settings::FOREIGN_HIGH_LEVEL_POKEMON_CAN_DISOBEY && @pokemon.foreign?(@battle.pbPlayer))
  118       if @level > badge_level
  119         a = ((@level + badge_level) * @battle.pbRandom(256) / 256).floor
  120         disobedient |= (a >= badge_level)
  121       end
  122     end
  123     disobedient |= !pbHyperModeObedience(choice[2])
  124     return true if !disobedient
  125     # Pokémon is disobedient; make it do something else
  126     return pbDisobey(choice, badge_level)
  127   end

  129   def pbDisobey(choice, badge_level)
  130     move = choice[2]
  131     PBDebug.log("[Disobedience] #{pbThis} disobeyed")
  132     @effects[PBEffects::Rage] = false
  133     # Do nothing if using Snore/Sleep Talk
  134     if @status == :SLEEP && move.usableWhenAsleep?
  135       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} ignored orders and kept sleeping!", pbThis))
  136       return false
  137     end
  138     b = ((@level + badge_level) * @battle.pbRandom(256) / 256).floor
  139     # Use another move
  140     if b < badge_level
  141       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} ignored orders!", pbThis))
  142       return false if !@battle.pbCanShowFightMenu?(@index)
  143       otherMoves = []
  144       eachMoveWithIndex do |_m, i|
  145         next if i == choice[1]
  146         otherMoves.push(i) if @battle.pbCanChooseMove?(@index, i, false)
  147       end
  148       return false if otherMoves.length == 0   # No other move to use; do nothing
  149       newChoice = otherMoves[@battle.pbRandom(otherMoves.length)]
  150       choice[1] = newChoice
  151       choice[2] = @moves[newChoice]
  152       choice[3] = -1
  153       return true
  154     end
  155     c = @level - badge_level
  156     r = @battle.pbRandom(256)
  157     # Fall asleep
  158     if r < c && pbCanSleep?(self, false)
  159       pbSleepSelf(_INTL("{1} began to nap!", pbThis))
  160       return false
  161     end
  162     # Hurt self in confusion
  163     r -= c
  164     if r < c && @status != :SLEEP
  165       pbConfusionDamage(_INTL("{1} won't obey! It hurt itself in its confusion!", pbThis))

    4 module ItemHandlers
    5   UseText             = ItemHandlerHash.new
    6   UseFromBag          = ItemHandlerHash.new
    7   ConfirmUseInField   = ItemHandlerHash.new
    8   UseInField          = ItemHandlerHash.new
    9   UseOnPokemon        = ItemHandlerHash.new
   10   UseOnPokemonMaximum = ItemHandlerHash.new
   11   CanUseInBattle      = ItemHandlerHash.new
   12   UseInBattle         = ItemHandlerHash.new
   13   BattleUseOnBattler  = ItemHandlerHash.new
   14   BattleUseOnPokemon  = ItemHandlerHash.new
   15 
   16   def self.hasUseText(item)
   17     return !UseText[item].nil?
   18   end
   19 
   20   # Shows "Use" option in Bag.
   21   def self.hasOutHandler(item)
   22     return !UseFromBag[item].nil? || !UseInField[item].nil? || !UseOnPokemon[item].nil?
   23   end
   24 
   25   # Shows "Register" option in Bag.
   26   def self.hasUseInFieldHandler(item)
   27     return !UseInField[item].nil?
   28   end
   29 
   30   def self.hasUseOnPokemon(item)
   31     return !UseOnPokemon[item].nil?
   32   end
   33 
   34   def self.hasUseOnPokemonMaximum(item)
   35     return !UseOnPokemonMaximum[item].nil?
   36   end
   37 
   38   def self.hasUseInBattle(item)
   39     return !UseInBattle[item].nil?
   40   end
   41 
   42   def self.hasBattleUseOnBattler(item)
   43     return !BattleUseOnBattler[item].nil?
   44   end
   45 
   46   def self.hasBattleUseOnPokemon(item)
   47     return !BattleUseOnPokemon[item].nil?
   48   end
   49 
   50   # Returns text to display instead of "Use"
   51   def self.getUseText(item)
   52     return UseText.trigger(item)
   53   end
   54 
   55   # Return value:
   56   # 0 - Item not used
   57   # 1 - Item used, don't end screen
   58   # 2 - Item used, end screen
   59   def self.triggerUseFromBag(item)
   60     return UseFromBag.trigger(item) if UseFromBag[item]
   61     # No UseFromBag handler exists; check the UseInField handler if present
   62     if UseInField[item]
   63       return (UseInField.trigger(item)) ? 1 : 0
   64     end
   65     return 0
   66   end
   67 
   68   # Returns whether item can be used
   69   def self.triggerConfirmUseInField(item)
   70     return true if !ConfirmUseInField[item]
   71     return ConfirmUseInField.trigger(item)
   72   end
   73 
   74   # Return value:
   75   # -1 - Item effect not found
   76   # 0  - Item not used
   77   # 1  - Item used
   78   def self.triggerUseInField(item)
   79     return -1 if !UseInField[item]
   80     return (UseInField.trigger(item)) ? 1 : 0
   81   end
   82 
   83   # Returns whether item was used
   84   def self.triggerUseOnPokemon(item, qty, pkmn, scene)
   85     return false if !UseOnPokemon[item]
   86     return UseOnPokemon.trigger(item, qty, pkmn, scene)
   87   end
   88 
   89   # Returns the maximum number of the item that can be used on the Pokémon at once.
   90   def self.triggerUseOnPokemonMaximum(item, pkmn)
   91     return 1 if !UseOnPokemonMaximum[item]
   92     return 1 if !Settings::USE_MULTIPLE_STAT_ITEMS_AT_ONCE
   93     return [UseOnPokemonMaximum.trigger(item, pkmn), 1].max
   94   end
   95 
   96   def self.triggerCanUseInBattle(item, pkmn, battler, move, firstAction, battle, scene, showMessages = true)
   97     return true if !CanUseInBattle[item]   # Can use the item by default
   98     return CanUseInBattle.trigger(item, pkmn, battler, move, firstAction, battle, scene, showMessages)
   99   end

   29   proc { |item| GameData::Item.get(item).is_poke_ball? },
   30   proc { |item, pokemon, battler, move, firstAction, battle, scene, showMessages|
   31     if battle.pbPlayer.party_full? && $PokemonStorage.full?
   32       scene.pbDisplay(_INTL("There is no room left in the PC!")) if showMessages
   33       next false
   34     end
   35     if battle.disablePokeBalls
   36       scene.pbDisplay(_INTL("You can't throw a Poké Ball!")) if showMessages
   37       next false
   38     end
   39     # NOTE: Using a Poké Ball consumes all your actions for the round. The code
   40     #       below is one half of making this happen; the other half is in def
   41     #       pbItemUsesAllActions?.
   42     if !firstAction
   43       scene.pbDisplay(_INTL("It's impossible to aim without being focused!")) if showMessages
   44       next false
   45     end
   46     if battler.semiInvulnerable?
   47       scene.pbDisplay(_INTL("It's no good! It's impossible to aim at a Pokémon that's not in sight!")) if showMessages
   48       next false
   49     end
   50     # NOTE: The code below stops you from throwing a Poké Ball if there is more
   51     #       than one unfainted opposing Pokémon. (Snag Balls can be thrown in
   52     #       this case, but only in trainer battles, and the trainer will deflect
   53     #       them if they are trying to catch a non-Shadow Pokémon.)
   54     if battle.pbOpposingBattlerCount > 1 && !(GameData::Item.get(item).is_snag_ball? && battle.trainerBattle?)
   55       if battle.pbOpposingBattlerCount == 2
   56         scene.pbDisplay(_INTL("It's no good! It's impossible to aim when there are two Pokémon!")) if showMessages
   57       elsif showMessages
   58         scene.pbDisplay(_INTL("It's no good! It's impossible to aim when there is more than one Pokémon!"))
   59       end
   60       next false
   61     end
   62     next true
   63   }
   64 )

   32   def pbCalcTypeModSingle(moveType, defType, user, target)
   33     ret = Effectiveness.calculate(moveType, defType)

   44       # Miracle Eye

   46         ret = Effectiveness::NORMAL_EFFECTIVE_MULTIPLIER
   47       end
   48     elsif Effectiveness.super_effective_type?(moveType, defType)
   49       # Delta Stream's weather
   50       if target.effectiveWeather == :StrongWinds && defType == :FLYING
   51         ret = Effectiveness::NORMAL_EFFECTIVE_MULTIPLIER
   52       end
   53     end
   54     # Grounded Flying-type Pokémon become susceptible to Ground moves

   61   def pbCalcTypeMod(moveType, user, target)
   62     ret = Effectiveness::NORMAL_EFFECTIVE_MULTIPLIER
   63     return ret if !moveType
   64     return ret if moveType == :GROUND && target.pbHasType?(:FLYING) && target.hasActiveItem?(:IRONBALL)
   65     # Get effectivenesses
   66     if moveType == :SHADOW
   67       if target.shadowPokemon?
   68         ret = Effectiveness::NOT_VERY_EFFECTIVE_MULTIPLIER
   69       else
   70         ret = Effectiveness::SUPER_EFFECTIVE_MULTIPLIER
   71       end
   72     else
   73       target.pbTypes(true).each do |type|
   74         ret *= pbCalcTypeModSingle(moveType, type, user, target)
   75       end

   77     end
   78     return ret
   79   end

   86   # Accuracy calculations for one-hit KO moves are handled elsewhere.
   87   def pbAccuracyCheck(user, target)
   88     # "Always hit" effects and "always hit" accuracy
   89     return true if target.effects[PBEffects::Telekinesis] > 0
   90     return true if target.effects[PBEffects::Minimize] && tramplesMinimize? && Settings::MECHANICS_GENERATION >= 6
   91     baseAcc = pbBaseAccuracy(user, target)
   92     return true if baseAcc == 0
   93     # Calculate all multiplier effects
   94     modifiers = {}
   95     modifiers[:base_accuracy]  = baseAcc
   96     modifiers[:accuracy_stage] = user.stages[:ACCURACY]
   97     modifiers[:evasion_stage]  = target.stages[:EVASION]
   98     modifiers[:accuracy_multiplier] = 1.0
   99     modifiers[:evasion_multiplier]  = 1.0
  100     pbCalcAccuracyModifiers(user, target, modifiers)
  101     # Check if move can't miss
  102     return true if modifiers[:base_accuracy] == 0
  103     # Calculation
  104     max_stage = Battle::Battler::STAT_STAGE_MAXIMUM
  105     accStage = [[modifiers[:accuracy_stage], -max_stage].max, max_stage].min + max_stage
  106     evaStage = [[modifiers[:evasion_stage], -max_stage].max, max_stage].min + max_stage
  107     stageMul = Battle::Battler::ACC_EVA_STAGE_MULTIPLIERS
  108     stageDiv = Battle::Battler::ACC_EVA_STAGE_DIVISORS
  109     accuracy = 100.0 * stageMul[accStage] / stageDiv[accStage]
  110     evasion  = 100.0 * stageMul[evaStage] / stageDiv[evaStage]
  111     accuracy = (accuracy * modifiers[:accuracy_multiplier]).round
  112     evasion  = (evasion  * modifiers[:evasion_multiplier]).round
  113     evasion = 1 if evasion < 1
  114     threshold = modifiers[:base_accuracy] * accuracy / evasion
  115     # Calculation
  116     r = @battle.pbRandom(100)
  117     if Settings::AFFECTION_EFFECTS && @battle.internalBattle &&
  118        target.pbOwnedByPlayer? && target.affection_level == 5 && !target.mega?
  119       return true if r < threshold - 10
  120       target.damageState.affection_missed = true if r < threshold
  121       return false
  122     end
  123     return r < threshold
  124   end

  130         user.ability, modifiers, user, target, self, @calcType
